nodes.name: README.md
preview: **Your morning newspaper, made from the things you actually read.**
Chai Reader is a calm SvelteKit reader for RSS feeds, YouTube channels,
subreddits, Hacker News pages, GitHub releases, and forwarded newsletters. It
supports a browser-only guest preview, account-backed sources, read-later saves,
filters, and optional AI briefing/podcast features.
- Guest preview: try up to 5 public sources with no account. Sources live in a
temporary `guest_feeds` cookie and can be saved after sign-up.
- Reader dashboard: folders, source filtering, keyboard navigation, saved
articles, reading preferences, and mobile drawer reading.
- Newsletter intake: signed-in users can generate an email forwarding address.
- Briefing and podcast: paid-tier functionality is present in code, but gated by
- One-time support: `/chai` hosts the public chai wall and Stripe checkout flow.
